groups.label: Abraxodyne Tapes
groups.sub: Bodhi gives you one for every batch of Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases you bring him.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 01

location.text: Bodhi gives you this holotape when you hand in batch 1 of 15: 3 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases (3 in total). Hand them in at Abraxodyne Chemical's Legal Office in Athens.

routes.name: Dirty Laundry - hand-in 1 (3 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases in total)

items.lead: A holotape Bodhi hands you during Dirty Laundry.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Okay folks, we've finally got the results back from the consumer surveys! These ones were to gauge attitudes towards the Abraxodyne Chemical brand.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: We did good, but the board thinks we can do better. They've asked for a full rebranding campaign that focuses on cementing a "family-friendly" image.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: I want us all to put our heads together on this one and come up with some standout ideas. Don't hold back - think big, think bold!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: What about a new mascot? I-I'm thinking an anthropomorphic bubble named "Squeaky" who teaches kids good hygiene and traditional values.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: A what? No, Martin, get it together, for Pete's sake!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How about a commercial? We have the brand recognition and the budget to make something memorable. Lots of the big brands are doing it!

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: A commercial... I like it. We'll need a catchy slogan to go with it too, of course. Something to really sell the "wholesome" angle.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Say no more, say no more, I have got it! "We're soft on fabrics, but hard on Communism!" Not bad, eh? Tell me that's not our pièce de résistance.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Ugh, Martin...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How about we pick something that showcases our values?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Oh, I've got one. "Abraxodyne Chemical: For families who put clean living first."

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: That's perfect, they'll eat that "family first" baloney right up. Nice work Janice.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: All right, good work everybody. Now that's out of the way, let's discuss next quarter's recruitment strategies.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 02

location.text: Bodhi gives you this holotape when you hand in batch 2 of 15: 3 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases (6 in total). Hand them in at Abraxodyne Chemical's Legal Office in Athens.

routes.name: Dirty Laundry - hand-in 2 (6 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases in total)

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Our Marketing, P.R. and R&D departments have all been hard at work this quarter crafting our new employee instructional video.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: As requested, we've covered the major areas of concern that have been "problematic" in recent years. So, let's see what you think. Roll the tape.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Welcome, employee. Whether this is your first time donning the Abraxodyne Chemical overalls or the hundredth, this training video is for you!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: By following these simple steps and adhering to our new mandatory safety protocols, you'll be keeping yourself, and the company, out of harm's way.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Employees are expected to take full, personal responsibility for their own actions and for the safety of their team. Remember: safety is no accident!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Deviation from our chemical handling procedures can have serious consequences; for you, and for the lab.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: *Scream*

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Oops! That's gotta sting. Remember folks, follow the safety procedures outlined in the employee handbook or face the consequences.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Our patented cleaning formula should be tough on grime, not tough on you. Report to a supervisor immediately if you encounter any infractions.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Here at Abraxodyne Chemical, we like to keep things spotless. But, did you know that cleanliness starts with what you say?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: That's right. Gossip and rumors leave a nasty stain on you and the company. Best to steer clear of the grapevine and avoid the unwanted repercussions.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: When you signed your contract with us, you joined something bigger than yourself. Bigger than detergent. You joined a family.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: And as family, we ask only for the loyalty, commitment, and trust that we've invested into you. Please read your contracts for more details.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: So don't forget, the success of Abraxodyne Chemical lies with you. Stick to these guidelines and we'll all shine!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: *Sigh*

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: Something on your mind, Ms. Amrita?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: No, no. Just another lousy meeting where I'm asked to achieve the impossible.

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: That so? Was it as bad as the one last week?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Hah! Worse, in fact. You don't know the half of it Moses.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: You know, sometimes I wonder how we keep getting into these screw-ups, especially after Pittsburgh. I'm always the one left to pick up the pieces.

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: You're a hard worker, Ms. Amrita. Why, I always see you running around here, busy as a one-legged man in a butt-kicking contest!

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: Dealing with the bumps in the road ain't easy, but I'm sure the fine folks here appreciate your efforts.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I really wish I believed you, but sometimes I feel like I'm one bad P.R. statement away from being thrown under the bus.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I've got to start looking into ways to protect myself a bit more... We've all got to cover our backs right?

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 04

location.text: Bodhi gives you this holotape when you hand in batch 4 of 15: 3 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases (12 in total). Hand them in at Abraxodyne Chemical's Legal Office in Athens.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Here you go, ma'am, you can call the number on the back to find more details about Abraxodyne's newest-

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Terry... Terry!

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: What? I'm with a customer right now. Apologies, ma'am, that flyer should have all the info you need. C'mon man, you're distracting me!

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Some guy was just asking me the weirdest questions!

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Yeah, so? People are meant to come and ask us questions, that's why we're here.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Here we are sir, let us know if you'd like any more information.

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Yeah, but this guy was crazy. Get a load of this: He was asking me questions about all the "incidents" the company's had in the last few years and-

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: For the love of God, Ronny! Tell me you didn't give him any details, you're gonna get us both fired!

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Relax, will ya? I'm not an idiot. I remember what they told us in the briefing.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: There we go, ma'am. Come by the booth again, if you have questions.

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Anyways, I tell him to get bent 'cause I'm not gonna accidentally spill the beans to some undercover reporter looking for a scoop.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Oh great, so now we're gonna get written up for insulting the public!

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Take it easy will ya? I did it all professional-like! He told me that he was with the military and that they're interested in our product's potential.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Interested? Interested how?

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: I'm not sure. But, it smells like a bonus if we can take it up the chain.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Yeah... Yeah, maybe you're right. Okay, well what are we waiting for? Let's go find him!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Come on Martin, you're one good idea away from getting that promotion, I can feel it!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: The others might laugh at me now, but they won't once I'm in charge, that's for sure.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: I just need something that will grab the board's attention, something that will really blow their socks off...

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Ooo! What about a special edition of Abraxo called "Atomic Sparkle" with trace elements of Uranium. "Your clothes will come out glowing... literally!"

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: No, that will never get through the safety tests! Definitely not after our last whoopsie with radioactive ingredients.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Perhaps we take a different approach? How about an actual soap opera named "Suds Galore"? Where the laundry is clean but the drama is anything but!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: We could even have a talking washing machine voiced by a celebrity to plug our latest products and deal bonanzas.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: No... Far too whimsical, and may give children nightmares.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: I've got it! A line of air fresheners dedicated to American presidents.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: We could have Teddy Roosevelt Tang: Raw, musky, slightly peppery. Smells like gunpowder and moustache wax.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Or-or Truman Spice: Sharp, direct, strong. A smell that isn't afraid to make hard decisions or send the Communists packing!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Voila, it's perfect, I've cracked it! If the board doesn't like this one, I'll eat my hat!

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: I've told you before, I don't feel comfortable getting in front of any cameras until we've had a proper review of our lab safety requirements!

transcript.speaker: Sheila
transcript.text: And that's been duly noted, Julius. We appreciate you bringing it to our attention, again. Your concern for your fellow lab techs is commendable.

transcript.speaker: Sheila
transcript.text: However, the board has stated several times that they want our lead researcher to be present in this new commercial to add credibility.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: If the board wants credibility then they need to put their money where their mouth is, and start listening to our concerns.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Not spending the budget on flashy commercials instead of the proper safety equipment I've had on the docket for over six months!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Your equipment requests have been received and are currently being reviewed by our finance team for validity.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Validity? My guys are burning through a respirator a day with the old kits! We need stronger equipment if you want us to work on this type of stuff.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: That's enough, Julius. Or do you need reminding of the confidentiality agreement you signed?

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: We need you in the new advertisement, simple as that. Anyhow, you're obligated to perform certain public appearances. Check your contract.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It won't be too strenuous Julius. You'll be fully prepared beforehand and I'll personally see to it that you get your equipment. How does that sound?

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Fine! I'll give you one afternoon, but no more. Someone needs to be supervising the lab techs, given the situation.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Well, I'm glad that's finally sorted. Why the sudden need for stronger respirators though? Our standard equipment has served us fine for years, no?

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Probably best to leave those details to the experts for now. Thanks for your help today, Amrita. I'll send you the shooting schedule for the ad soon.

transcript.speaker: Janitor 1
transcript.text: I mean, how do they expect us to work in these conditions?

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: You said it, pal. Complete joke, if you ask me.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Just a little louder, come on...

transcript.speaker: Janitor 1
transcript.text: It's bad enough that they won't give us any of the new hazmat suits, but not replacing clearly broken equipment?

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: It's downright dangerous if you ask me. And with the wages we're earning, it's hardly worth the risk.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Ugh, I can barely hear them. Maybe it was a mistake hiding in here.

transcript.speaker: Janitor 1
transcript.text: Jake's the third person working this shift who's gone off sick in a month. Now don't tell me that's a coincidence, 'cause I ain't stupid!

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: Hey, at least you weren't the one who inherited his mop. Look at this thing - what was he mopping up with it? Lava?

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: You can't use that mangled piece of crap. You'd be better off using a wad of paper towels at this rate. Let me grab my spare from the store cupboard.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Oh shi-

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 08

location.text: Bodhi gives you this holotape when you hand in batch 8 of 15: 5 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases (30 in total). Hand them in at Abraxodyne Chemical's Legal Office in Athens.

routes.name: Dirty Laundry - hand-in 8 (30 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases in total)

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Hmm, note to self: Check with R&D boys about investigating an edible detergent. A tasty snack that delights the mind and cleans the stomach!

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Oh, it's you...

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Ah, Kerry, hello! I was just looking for you actually. I have another brilliant idea; I think you're going to really like this one.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: What is it this time, Martin?

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: I call it "shower-in-a-can": It's an aerosol spray that eliminates the need for bathing. Convenient for the modern go-getter!

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Yeah, okay, that's great and all, but listen - I have some actual work for you to do. We have a new... product that we need a company codename for.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Ah excellent, I'm quite a wunderkind at that sort of thing. So, what's the new product? I'll be able to whip up a name for you, tout de suite.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Don't worry about what it is, that's classified information. Just make sure it sounds appealing and, uh... clean. Have it on my desk by five.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Right, think Martin, you can do this. Needs to be something fresh, something invigorating. "Spring Clean"? No, too obvious.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Nature... purity; something delicate-sounding that won't overstay its welcome, like a polite dinner guest. Meadow-something, perhaps?

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: "Meadow Glade"? Hm, no-no, not quite. "Meadow Whisper" maybe? No, too sultry. Ah, what about "Meadow Breeze"!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Yes, that's it! "Meadow Breeze"! Gentle, yet exciting. Fragrant, yet sophisticated. It screams business but with a delightful je ne sais quoi.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: God, I'm good! Note to self: Ask Kerry for a raise.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 09

location.text: Bodhi gives you this holotape when you hand in batch 9 of 15: 5 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases (35 in total). Hand them in at Abraxodyne Chemical's Legal Office in Athens.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: All right everybody, quiet on set please. Roll sound, roll camera. Take 1. And... action!

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Here at Abraxodyne Chemical, we're pioneering the latest and greatest in cleaning products, engineered to brighten your whites and your day... We-

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Cut, CUT! Listen buddy, I know you're probably used to being down in the lab all day and whatnot, but I'm gonna need a little bit more verve, okay?

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: It's hard to be enthusiastic when you're making me read this drivel! Whoever wrote this should spend a hot minute in my lab, then-

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Okay folks, let's take five and give the "talent" time to blow off some... steam.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Julius, I know this might feel like baloney to you, but we're just trying to go for the most family-friendly vibe we can.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Family-friendly? Amrita, I know you're in charge of the P.R. here, but I didn't think you'd fall for that line yourself!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I-

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: All right, back to positions everybody. Let's take it from the second scene. And here we go!

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Don't forget to collect your "Abraxo-bucks", found in all eligible Abraxodyne products, for your chance to win a year's supply of premium detergent.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: For all your cleaning needs, think Abraxodyne Chemical: For families who put clean living first... Really? Is that what we're going with?

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: CUT!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I'm recording this to say, that enough is enough. This... This is getting out of hand now and somebody has to do... something.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It started out with keeping receipts in case the board ever tried to pin one of their screw-ups on me. Just so I had a bit of leverage... Anything.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: But every stone I've unturned, the rot goes deeper and deeper. The more I look, the more I find...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Isn't it my job to know the ugly stuff; so I can shield the brand and help us focus on what really helps people?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Whatever we're doing now, it goes a hell of a lot deeper than the circles I'm part of.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: And this "Meadow Breeze" project I've seen referenced in new data entries... I can't tell exactly what it is, but I do not like the look of it.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I think... I think I need to keep going. I wish I could put this genie back in the bottle and turn a blind eye but, this has all gone too far now

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Somebody's got to hold them to account. And if not me, then who?

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 11

location.text: Bodhi gives you this holotape when you hand in batch 11 of 15: 6 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases (47 in total). Hand them in at Abraxodyne Chemical's Legal Office in Athens.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: How did we get to this stage in the first place, Kerry? I thought we agreed to can this idea after the failure of the first round of testing?

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: We did, but, we were very close, so I encouraged the boys to keep working on an improved formula in their down time.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: This is unacceptable. Even entertaining the idea of developing this "Meadow Breeze" weapon flies in the face of what this company stands for.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: I hear your concerns, I do, but think of it this way: If we get this right, then Abraxodyne Chemical will be helping protect our troops oversees.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: This stuff is so strong, it could be used as a deterrent against the Commies! Who knows, it might even prevent a war. Now that's patriotic!

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Patriotic? What malarkey! Have you lost your mind? We're a family company, Kerry, remember? That's just not how we do things here.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: I reckoned some of you might not be on board yet, so I took the liberty of compiling the projected revenue from the military contract.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: Mother of God...

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Well, when you put it that way... Perhaps it wouldn't hurt for the company to get with the times a bit more.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: Yeah, and I suppose we do have a national duty to protect our boys in uniform, after all. It'll be great for morale and market share. *chuckle*

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 12

location.text: Bodhi gives you this holotape when you hand in batch 12 of 15: 7 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases (54 in total). Hand them in at Abraxodyne Chemical's Legal Office in Athens.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I know, ma, but I don't really have a choice right now.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I never thought I'd get promoted out of a secretary position in the first place. I can't mess this up!

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: It's 'cause of this new "genius" contest idea that Tony came up with. Y'know the "Abraxo-bucks" one?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: It wouldn't have been so bad if they'd done the cost projections before committing to it, but now they've realized they can't have "so many winners".

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Now I've got to sort through the distribution data and make sure it's "statistically unlikely" for anyone to actually collect enough of these tickets.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I can't demand that, ma.*Sigh* I'm just going to have to keep staying late until it's done. I'm too afraid to make a fuss about it.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I know, I know you're right. Anyways, can you put Mikey's dinner in the oven and put the kids to bed for me please? Love you.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: *Sigh*

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Hey, Janice.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Oh, hey Amrita, didn't see you back there! Don't mind what I was saying to my mom, she just worries is all. Everything's fine!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How about you take off and go spend some time with those kids, huh? Tell Tony he can talk to me if he's got a problem with it.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Oh, Amrita, are you sure? I don't want to get you in any trouble. I could really use the sleep though...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It's fine, get out of here, go get some rest. Don't worry, I'll lock up around here after you're gone.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 13

location.text: Bodhi gives you this holotape when you hand in batch 13 of 15: 7 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases (61 in total). Hand them in at Abraxodyne Chemical's Legal Office in Athens.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: For the love of God, I am getting sick of this! It is ridiculous! Every damn thing we say ends up getting leaked to the press somehow!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: How are we even meant to have these meetings if there's no guarantee they won't end up in the hands of reporters?

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: All right, Harold, let's keep calm. Indiscretion has caused enough problems already. We just need to tighten up our flow of information, that's all.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: We're lucky that this reporter was caught and dealt with before anything could be published and our brand permanently damaged.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Even so, everything points to this being an inside job! How else would they have heard about project Meadow Breeze?

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: That is true. How about this then: If the mole is in this room, come forward, and we can smooth this all out. Right here, right now.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: No? Well, it was worth a try. So be it, tomorrow we'll begin upscaling our internal investigations and, if needed, we won't hesitate to-

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: What was that?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Sorry, I, uh... dropped my handbag.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: As I was saying, we will do whatever is needed to get to the bottom of this.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 14

location.text: Bodhi gives you this holotape when you hand in batch 14 of 15: 7 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases (68 in total). Hand them in at Abraxodyne Chemical's Legal Office in Athens.

routes.name: Dirty Laundry - hand-in 14 (68 Abraxodyne Intel Briefcases in total)

items.lead: A holotape Bodhi hands you during Dirty Laundry.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: This tape is being recorded for my own protection, as well as everyone else's. They're getting close, but I can't stop now.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It's taken months and several near-misses, but I think I've collected enough evidence to finally hold these bastards to account.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I don't even know who I should show this stuff to - a lawyer? The police? Hell, even the press?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: The important thing is this: project "Meadow Breeze" is not a cleaning product. It's some kind of awful, deadly weapon, and I can prove it.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How it can decimate crops, ecosystems, hell even metal! It's all here in these reports. God only knows what its long term impact on human beings is!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How did I not realize all of this sooner? Julius was practically spelling it out to me all along. I've been so stupid...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I'll admit, I've had a part to play in our cover ups over the years, but not this. Never this.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I don't have much time. The board are tying up loose ends and it won't be long before they notice things going missing. I need to get out, and soon.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: All that's left is to listen to these few extra tapes I swiped from the security room. Here goes:

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: Dealing with the bumps in the road ain't easy, but I'm sure the fine folks here appreciate your efforts.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I've got to start looking into ways to protect myself a bit more... We've all got to cover our backs, right?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Wait, but that's back when I was talking to... How did they get their hands on my copy? Oh God, oh God! I need to-

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Hi, Janice! Come in, take a seat.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How's everything going? Is the "Abraxo-bucks" initiative making good progress?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: It's going swell, thanks. But I actually had something else I wanted to talk to you about.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Oh. Well I'm always happy to talk things through. What's on your mind?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: You remember that problem the board had with the "flow of information"? From what I hear, they're getting mighty close to solving it.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Huh. Well I'm glad to hear that things are-

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: And if I was someone involved in that situation whatsoever, I would sure start thinking about moving on. Sooner rather than later.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Alrighty, well, I've gotta skedaddle now. It was really nice chatting with you again Amrita. Take care, won't you?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Oh God...

items.name: Intercepted Message
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Status report:

Abraxodyne is cornering us out of the market. Whether it's prime real-estate or some dinky field, they are outbidding us every step of the way.

Surveys of the 2050's fire sites came back as expected. Widespread burning springs, likely connected to a massive natural gas reservoir. Their frequency over the years only increases the potential value in this land.

None of that matters if we can't get firm footing here. Big Meadows was a failure, and the Harper's Ferry site would need decades of work to reach anywhere close to here. Running out of options.

That said, I cannot in good conscience recommend that crackpot Lewisburg plan. I've no reason to believe the reservoir extends that far out. There's a good chance we've gotten false information on how lucrative that site could be.

NOTE: Intercepted by our man at Bysshe. Let's keep the pressure on.
